contexts.text: I have gotten a man Jehovah. AC 347.

All the substance that they had acquired = all things that are sensual truths. All the Scientific from which a man thinks is called substance; without acquired scientifics man as man cannot have any idea of thought.
Their substance was great and they could not dwell together = the things that have been acquired by the inward man cannot agree with those that have been acquired in the outward man.
Possessions or acquisitions.
Whatever a man has once acquired remains.
(Acquirere and comparare used synonymously.)
They took Lot and his substance = the outward man as to apparent goods and truths. AC 1717. AC 1718.
Remains acquired in combats...
Soul = the life, substance = the rest, which are not so properly the life.
The substance of the king of Sodom = evil and falsity.
They shall come out with great substance = celestial and spiritual good. Explained.
That the Lord acquired all things by His own powers. Signified.
To Abraham for a possession = accepted by the Lord alone. A possession = what is His.
Possession of flock and possession of herd = as to interior good and as to exterior good.
Tradings = acquisitions.
He took away all his acquisition and all his substance that he had procured.... Acquisition = truth and substance, good... Acquisition in the Hebrew is a word that also signifies cattle in general.
The acquisitions that were bought were from another source.
Which the Lord acquired by His own power.
That he might acquire for himself the affections of truth.
Acquisitions in their order. Signified.
The acquirement of truth in the natural, treated of.
Acquisition [meaning cattle] = goods and truths in general. AC 4440.
Acquisition, when it is also cattle, = the good of truth.
And they took their cattle and their goods which they had gotten ... goods = truth procured, and also good procured.
Cattle, in the Hebrew, is from a word that also signifies acquisition, and acquisition in the spiritual sense is also the truth from which is good, for good is acquired through truth.
The form of the inward things that he has acquired.

Flock and herd, very much acquisition = good acquired through truth... that it has been acquired is signified by acquisition, for all the good of those who belong to the Spiritual Church is acquired through truth...
Good no longer acquired through truth. Signified, Explained. AC 8516:end, Explained. AC 8539, Explained.
They wished to acquire it, but it was not given. Signified.
Divine power acquired in the Human.
That He acquired this power when He was in the world. Signified.
